dedupe_keys.name: green infrastructure portal クリーンインフラホータルサイト mlit japan

description: The Green Infrastructure Portal is the Japanese government's entry point for green infrastructure policy, collecting the national Green Infrastructure Promotion Strategy 2030, technical guidelines, lists of support and subsidy schemes, the green infrastructure award and material from the public-private Green Infrastructure Partnership Platform founded in March 2020. It is run by the Policy Bureau of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism. Coverage is national, with examples from municipalities and companies across Japan. Format and access: web pages linking PDFs, in Japanese, free to read. Licence: the page says figures from the strategy may be reused with the citation 出典：グリーンインフラ推進戦略2030; other terms follow the MLIT site policy. Caveats: it is a document portal, not a dataset, and many links lead to other ministries or the platform's site. It supports adaptation and green infrastructure planning studies that need Japan's policy frame and funding routes. Related catalogue records are the platform's collection of green infrastructure examples and MLIT's urban greening database.
